newsitem.title: CHINA: China Southern offers 1.03 bln H-shrs in float.
newsitem.headline: China Southern offers 1.03 bln H-shrs in float.

text.p: China Southern Airlines Co Ltd said on Monday it is issuing 1.03 billion H-shares in a global flotation of which 71 million H-shares are being offered in Hong Kong at a price ranging from HK$3.71 to HK$4.70 each.
The issue price will represent a prospectus price earnings multiple of 13.2 to 16.8 times on a proforma fully-diluted basis and 12.0 to 15.2 times times on a weighted average basis.
The carrier will also grant underwriters an option to require the company to issue up to a further 154.5 million H-shares to cover overallotment.
The adjusted net tangible asset value per share is 2.09 yuan per H-share, the listing document said.
Of the total, 71 million H-shares will be offered to the public in Hong Kong and 353.51 million will be sold under the U.S. offering in the form of American Depository Shares (ADS).
